answer_4.quote: We employ human annotators to assess the quality of AM 2 ICO. For each dataset, we recruit two annotators who each validate a random sample of 100 examples, where 50 examples are shared between the two samples and are used to compute inter-rater agreement.
answer_4.guideline: The classification task is then to judge whether the words w i,src and w i,trg occurring in the respective contexts c i,src and c i,trg have the same sense/meaning (i.e., whether they refer to the same entity/concept), or not.
